items.title: Hackathon scanner: read Devpost's public hackathon API daily from CI, keep docs/hackathons/BOARD.md (open online hackathons with a cash pool, close date, requirements excerpt, UK eligibility, existing-project rule) and file a queue item for every entry whose requirements a live product already meets
items.why: Owner 2026-10-11: money already on offer must be collected, not waited for. Devpost lists 38 open online hackathons today (RESEARCH §2); which ones fit changes weekly and no routine reads the board. The API is keyless JSON (`/api/hackathons?status[]=open&challenge_type[]=online`); the rules page carries the prize table and eligibility. A GitHub runner reaches devpost.com (the routine sandbox may not): run it in the store-metrics job like the other store reads. Dropped 2026-10-11 (owner asked for a ToS check): Devpost's Terms of Service §4 forbid using automated software to access or scrape the site, so no scanner; hackathons are found by the weekly exchange from sponsors' own sites and the owner's pointers, one page read at a time.
items.proof: BOARD.md refreshed daily; every hackathon that fits has a queue item within a day of appearing

items.title: Demo video pipeline: a Playwright script per entry that drives the live product in a headless browser with on-screen captions, recorded to webm and converted to mp4 by ffmpeg in CI, published as a workflow artifact the owner attaches to the submission
items.why: Every Devpost portal asks for a short demo video and judges watch it first; no routine can record a screen today, so each entry would stall on the owner. Playwright's `recordVideo` and ffmpeg run on a GitHub runner; captions come from the script, no narration needed. First entry to record: the PayPal shot list is ventures/hackathons/entries/paypal-ai-hackathon/DEMO-SCRIPT.md (2026-10-11); when the mp4 exists, write the owner: line for action 023 and unblock paypal-ai-hackathon-submit. Built 2026-10-11 (burn-down): scripts/demo-video.ts (recorder, captions, webm→mp4) + scripts/demo-paypal-ai-hackathon.ts (the eight shots, live and dry-run modes) + docs/ci/demo-video.yml (dispatch; artifact demo-video-<entry>); a dry run recorded in the sandbox (1280×720 h264, captions on every frame). The live recording waits on the sandbox buyer login (action 024) — item demo-video-paypal-record.
items.proof: one mp4 under 3 minutes produced from CI for the first entry

items.title: PayPal AI Hackathon entry (closes 2026-11-12, $67,500 pool): a PayPal sandbox checkout for gankdat credits (Orders API, sandbox only) beside Stripe and x402, an agent walkthrough where Claude buys and spends credits through the MCP server, the Devpost write-up, repo link and demo video
items.why: RESEARCH §2: existing projects qualify with meaningful progress in the period, the PayPal integration must be central and AI meaningful — gankdat is already an AI-agent data product with two payment rails, so the sandbox rail is the whole new work. Prize tiers $12k / $8k / $5k plus category awards. Needs the owner's Devpost and PayPal developer sandbox accounts (action 022); the owner submits the package. Unblocked 2026-10-11: owner registered on Devpost and joined the hackathon; PayPal sandbox client id and secret are in .env and set as Worker secrets PAYPAL_SANDBOX_CLIENT_ID / PAYPAL_SANDBOX_SECRET (interactive). Sandbox only: no live PayPal money moves. Built 2026-10-11 (burn-down): gankdat v0.24.0 — PayPal Orders v2 sandbox credit packs (src/billing/paypal.ts, packs.json, migration 0017 paypal_orders, KV top-up balance spent after the plan allowance via metering/budget.ts), REST POST /v1/billing/paypal/orders + capture + browser return, MCP buy_credits / confirm_credit_purchase (protected), /account credit-pack buttons, terms §6, OpenAPI, 10 tests; write-up, agent transcript and shot list in ventures/hackathons/entries/paypal-ai-hackathon/, scripts/paypal-walkthrough.mjs. The video is demo-video-pipeline's; the submission is paypal-ai-hackathon-submit (owner, action 023).
items.proof: submission accepted on Devpost before the deadline; any placing is the venture's proof

items.title: Nebius × NVIDIA hackathon entry (closes 2026-10-30, $50,000 pool): a UK counterparty due-diligence agent on a Nemotron model served by Nebius Token Factory, using gankdat's MCP tools (companies, insolvency, sanctions, sponsors, charities) with a one-page report output; write-up, repo, demo video
items.why: RESEARCH §2: the only hard rule is running on Nebius with an NVIDIA open model; the 'best apps and agents' track wants something people would use. The agent is a thin orchestration over tools that already exist. Needs the owner's Devpost and Nebius accounts (action 022; drop if Nebius asks for a card). Dropped 2026-10-11: Nebius sign-up asked for a credit card (owner); the ledger rule allows no card on a £0 line. Revived 2026-10-13 (burn-down): Nebius welcomed the owner's Token Factory account on 2026-10-12 (inbox); the official billing page read through the relay says onboarding needs a bank card and grants US$1 of trial credit for 30 days, and Nemotron 3.5 Lightning / 3 Nano cost US$0.06 in, US$0.24 out per million tokens — a whole entry is well under US$2 with the call cap below. Split into nebius-diligence-agent (buildable now, dry-run) and nebius-nvidia-hackathon-submit (owner key, action 025).
items.proof: submission accepted on Devpost before the deadline

items.title: Record the PayPal AI Hackathon demo video: run the `demo video` workflow (entry paypal-ai-hackathon) once the sandbox buyer secrets exist, check the artifact (mp4 under 3 min, every shot present), paste its run link into action 023 and write the owner: line for the submission
items.why: The pipeline is built (demo-video-pipeline, 2026-10-11) and verified with a dry run; the PayPal approval shot logs in as the owner's sandbox buyer, whose email and password are the PAYPAL_SANDBOX_BUYER_* repository secrets (action 024). A routine fires the workflow with actions_run_trigger and reads the run with actions_get; a failed PayPal login shows in the run log (selectors #email, #password, #payment-submit-btn — fix the script if PayPal's sandbox page changed). Artifacts expire after 60 days: record no earlier than needed and before 2026-11-12. Done 2026-10-11 (interactive): run 38171740523 produced paypal-ai-hackathon.mp4 (2 min 24 s, eight shots, sandbox approval completed); fixes on the way: PayPal login iframe + failure evidence, ffmpeg on the runner.
items.proof: one mp4 under 3 minutes in the workflow's artifact, listed in action 023

items.title: Submit the PayPal AI Hackathon entry on Devpost (owner, action 023): paste SUBMISSION.md, attach the demo video, repo and try-it links; record the submission URL in RESEARCH.md
items.why: The entry is built (paypal-ai-hackathon-entry, 2026-10-11) and submissions close 2026-11-12; Devpost's Terms forbid automated access, so the owner submits by hand from docs/for-owner/actions/023-paypal-hackathon-submission.md. Waits on the demo video (every Devpost portal asks for one).
items.proof: submission accepted on Devpost before 2026-11-12; any placing is the venture's proof

items.title: Nebius × NVIDIA hackathon entry, part 1 (submissions close 2026-10-30 10:00 PT, $50,000 pool): a UK counterparty due-diligence agent on NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning served by Nebius Token Factory (OpenAI-compatible chat API) that calls gankdat's MCP tools over uk-companies, uk-company-profiles, uk-insolvency, uk-sanctions, uk-sponsors, uk-charities and uk-contract-awards and writes a one-page risk report; a hard spend guard (Nano-class model only, ≤ 40 model calls and ≤ 300k tokens per run, abort beyond); a recorded-fixture dry-run mode so the tests and the demo shot list run without a key; ventures/hackathons/entries/nebius-nvidia-hackathon/ with SUBMISSION.md draft, WALKTHROUGH.md and DEMO-SCRIPT.md; scripts/demo-nebius-hackathon.ts on the demo-video pipeline
items.why: RESEARCH §2 (rules read 2026-10-11): the only hard rule is running on Nebius with an NVIDIA open model; the 'apps and agents' track wants something people would use, and a due-diligence agent over seven official registers is one. RESEARCH §2b (2026-10-13, relay reads of docs.tokenfactory.nebius.com and nebius.com): Token Factory serves nvidia/Nemotron-3_5-Lightning and nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B at US$0.06 input / US$0.24 output per million tokens with a 262k–1M context, so a complete entry (build, tests, demo) stays under US$2; every account gets US$1 of trial credit for 30 days. The owner's Token Factory account is active since 2026-10-12 (inbox); the key arrives through action 025. Everything here runs against fixtures until then — the live run is the submit item. Built 2026-10-13 (burn-down): scripts/nebius-diligence-agent.ts (Token Factory tool loop, MCP tool discovery limited to the seven registers, Budget guard, dry-run model + fixtures, CLI) with 8 tests; entries/nebius-nvidia-hackathon/ SUBMISSION.md, WALKTHROUGH.md (dry-run transcript) and DEMO-SCRIPT.md. The recording script scripts/demo-nebius-nvidia-hackathon.ts moves to the submit item, where the live run it records happens.
items.proof: the agent produces a correct report for three real companies in dry-run and live mode; demo recorded under 3 minutes

items.title: Nebius × NVIDIA hackathon entry, part 2: write scripts/demo-nebius-nvidia-hackathon.ts from DEMO-SCRIPT.md on the demo-video pipeline, run the agent live on Token Factory with the owner's key, record the demo with the demo-video workflow (entry nebius-nvidia-hackathon), finish SUBMISSION.md with the live transcript, write the owner: line; the owner submits on Devpost by 2026-10-30 10:00 PT and the submission URL goes in RESEARCH.md
items.why: The live run needs NEBIUS_API_KEY in .env and as a repository secret (action 025: ~5 min, the owner also says whether a card is on the account — Nebius's billing page says onboarding needs one; the agent's call cap keeps the whole entry under US$2 and the ledger carries a £2 planned row). Devpost's Terms forbid automated access, so the owner submits by hand, as for action 023. Prize tiers $20k / $10k / $6k plus track awards (RESEARCH §2).
items.proof: submission accepted on Devpost before 2026-10-30; any placing is the venture's proof
items.blocked_on: nebius-diligence-agent built; owner action 025 (NEBIUS_API_KEY in .env and the repository secrets, billing state confirmed)

items.title: Re-read lablab.ai's 'The Rise of AI Agents' hackathon page (relay) for its online build window; when it is announced and at least five days away, file an entry item for the 'Best use of Vultr' cash track with the gankdat agent reused under an MIT-licensed entry folder
items.why: Read 2026-10-13 through the relay: lablab.ai lists the hackathon as hybrid (online build phase for everyone, on-site finale in Dubai by invitation), date 'Fall 2026 / TBA', solo entry allowed, 'Best use of Vultr' pays $5,000 / $3,000 / $1,000 cash plus API credits, 'Best use of Gemini' pays GCP credits only; submissions must be original and MIT-compliant (the entry's own code can be MIT while gankdat stays as is), and a project must deploy on a Vultr VM with 30-day credits (a payment method only if kept afterwards). Aggregators quote 26 Oct–2 Nov online; the official page does not, so the date is read, not assumed. Not an entry until the window is known.
items.proof: an entry item filed with the official dates, or the item dropped with the reason
